#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

int add(int a, int b) {
    int c = a + b;
    if (c >= MOD) return c - MOD;
    if (c < 0) return c + MOD;
    return c;
}

int mult(int a, int b) {
    return (int)((long long)a * b % MOD);
}

int mult(vector<int> x) {
    int r = 1;
    for (int y : x) {
        r = mult(r, y);
    }
    return r;
}

int stirling[5001][5001];

void pre() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 5001; i++) {
        stirling[i][0] = 0;
        stirling[0][1] = 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 5001; i++) {
        stirling[i][i] = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 2; i < 5001; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
            stirling[i][j] = add(mult(stirling[i - 1][j], i - 1), stirling[i - 1][j - 1]);
        }
    }
}

int modinv(int a) {
    int b = MOD, u = 1, v = 0;
    while (a) {
        int t = b / a;
        b -= t * a; swap(a, b);
        u -= t * v; swap(u, v);
    }
    if (u < 0) u += MOD;
    return u;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    pre();
    int n, m, k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    int invm = modinv(m);
    int pVal[5001];
    pVal[0] = 1;
    int md = n;
    int prp = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        prp = mult({prp, md, invm});
        md = add(md, -1);
        int sub = prp;
        for (int j = i - 1; j >= 1; j--) {
            int sign = ((i - j) % 2 == 1) ? pVal[j] : add(0, -pVal[j]);
            sub = add(sub, mult(stirling[i][j], sign));
        }
        pVal[i] = sub;
    }
    cout << pVal[k] << "\n";
    return 0;
}
